text:
maria-ss: FYI customer reported a sudden spike in randomness for their summarization endpoint after yesterday's config rollout. Ticket #5421. Example prompt + outputs attached.

ashwin: Can you paste the prompt + before/after responses?

maria-ss: Sure — short thread. Customer said they didn't change their client.

maria-ss: Prompt: 
```
Summarize the following article in 3 bullet points:
[ARTICLE TEXT REDACTED]
```

maria-ss: Response (expected, yesterday around 09:15):
```
• Key point one: clear concise summary.
• Key point two: precise fact A.
• Key point three: actionable takeaway.
```

maria-ss: Response (now):
```
• Mostly incoherent aside, mentions unrelated product names.
• Adds speculative details not in article.
• Long, digressive paragraph instead of 3 bullets.
```

ashwin: Huh. Any errors in the request logs? Could be sampling config drift.

maria-ss: I pulled the audit: their route was served by model redwood-bert-v2@stable. No explicit temperature/top_p in the request.

ops-bot: Deploy event: canary-config-update by jeremy at 2026-10-12T22:03:12Z — change id d4f7b2c — applied to 10% of prod routes.

jeremy: That was the autoscaler+presets change to reduce latency — we tweaked default "sampling_presets" in the runtime to align with new batching. I forgot to exclude chat/summarize routes.

ashwin: Can you paste the runtime config that was pushed?

jeremy: Here — pulled from deploy logs: 
```json
{"sampling_presets":{"default":{"temperature":0.8,"top_p":1.0},"conservative":{"temperature":0.2,"top_p":0.9}}}
```

ashwin: Yikes. The summarization routes should be using "conservative" by default. Looks like the default preset got set high. That would explain hallucinations and longer outputs.

sophia: Where is the binding between route and preset? Console rollout page or route config?

jeremy: It's in the model routing table — a recent migration changed unset routes to inherit the global default preset. The migration ran in the canary and then was promoted. Canary was 10% at deploy time but it likely hit some long-tail customers.

maria-ss: Customer says the behavior started ~22:10 UTC yesterday which matches the deploy timestamp.

ashwin: Action plan: 1) Rollback default sampling preset to previous values (set global default to conservative), 2) Patch migration to preserve per-route explicit presets, 3) Notify affected customers and offer credit.

jeremy: Rolling rollback to previous config now. Triggering quick rollback + promoting conservative preset as global default.

ops-bot: Rollback started: rollback-id r-9a7c3 — begun at 2026-10-12T22:28:10Z.

sophia: Can you include a repro note for the eng-runtime postmortem? We should capture: how to query a route's effective preset and differences between canary and promoted states.

ashwin: Repro steps for ticket: 
1) Call /v1/route-configs/<route-id> to see explicit preset binding.
2) If unset, call /v1/global-config to see default preset.
3) Send identical prompt with explicit sampling: {"temperature":0.2,"top_p":0.9} and compare.

maria-ss: Logged the customer's sample and repro steps in #5421. Customer on standby for a follow-up.

jeremy: Rollback finished and promoted conservative as global default. Change id r-9a7c3 applied.

ops-bot: Deploy event: rollback-complete r-9a7c3 at 2026-10-12T22:33:45Z.

ashwin: Sophia/eng-runtime — can you add a validation check to prevent new migrations from changing sampling presets unless explicitly approved in the rollout ticket?

sophia: Yep — I'll add a preflight that diffs preset bindings and warns. Also adding an alert if a global default is changed in a canary rollout.

maria-ss: I'll update the customer with the timeline and next steps. Suggest offering a small credit and a contact person.

jeremy: Sorry about the churn here — my change was intended to help latency but I missed the side effect. Will draft follow-up to explain and include mitigation. :hands_together:

maria-ss: Thanks everyone. Closing loop after customer confirms output normalized.

ashwin: Follow-up check: run the customer's prompt against redwood-bert-v2@stable with no preset, with conservative, and with the previous mutated default and store outputs in the ticket for audit.

maria-ss: On it. Will attach results in #5421 in next hour. :white_check_mark:
